scope: reference research, not automatic game-rule import
method: Local hash deduplication, safe archive member reads, read-only openpyxl, pypdf text extraction, Poppler/PIL visual previews; no references sent to DeepSeek.
coverage_limit: Extraction and classification are not a line-by-line editorial audit of every page, translation or card. Detailed reviewed pages are explicit; unlisted image pages remain for targeted scenario implementation.

sources.review: all 12 sheets parsed; data counts and selected skill/combo rows analysed; no source edits
